routing_changes.public_signal_planes: At first actual macro connection height, avoiding extra full-height bias feeds
routing_changes.caveat: Wire-span objective is geometry planning only; native DRC/LVS, fresh MIM-aware RC and unchanged full loaded electrical gates are required.

supply_overlay.scope: Twelve leaves retain parent-added supply risers; four new sampler leaves retain their physically verified native upper-metal routing. Exact actual child M6/M7 supply coverage is rechecked in the parent. Horizontal shunt via X offsets are4um for samplers and12um for other leaves to avoid opposite-rail riser crossings. Does not bypass any wire model or intrinsic device. Native fresh extraction and loaded gate remeasurement required. New XOR children have Metal5 ports and receive actual supply shunts and risers.

parent_avdd_bypass.scope: Eleven parent AVDD branches bypassed through native TM1/TM2; original branches, child geometry and all device values retained. Fresh RC and unchanged loaded gates required.
